translations.source_sense_description: historisch: als (ausgebildeter) Handwerker Schuhe herstellen und reparieren

glosses: A cobblestone.

examples.text: The narrow streets that twist and turn through the compact heart of Dent are surfaced with cobbles which, in the absence of pavements, spread right across from doorstep to doorstep.

glosses: A particle from 64 to 256 mm in diameter, following the Wentworth scale.
A piece of steel that becomes malformed during its manufacture or rolling.

examples.text: These men are located near the rolls in a pulpit, which is usually completely inclosed with heavy close-meshed netting or boiler plate, so that if a cobble occurs they will be protected from the rods which fly in all directions on such occasions.
The ideal control which they offer the reversing motor is such, when a cobble might be made in the steel mill, the metal can be handled gently, and very often the ingot saved.

In practical mill work a roller often has to wait days and sometimes weeks before he can catch this condition, as he could not consider the stopping of production while he made a cobble in some particular roll pass that was giving him trouble, and it is mainly by studying the cobbles that the action of the steel can be observed and studied.
Cameras pointed between stands could be saved for 5 or 7 days, enough to troubleshoot cobble or off-level mills.

glosses: To make shoes (what a cobbler does).
To assemble in an improvised way.

examples.text: I cobbled something together to get us through till morning.

glosses: To use cobblestones to pave a road, walkway, etc.
Alternative form of coble (“a kind of fishing-boat”).

製鞋，補鞋

examples.text: Auch ihr Gatte, seines Handwerks ein Schuhflicker, quartierte sich ganz fest in dem Nebenhause ein und saß hier den ganzen Tag und schusterte.
examples.translation: 她的丈夫也是個補鞋匠，在隔壁屋子裡安頓了下來，整天坐在那兒做著修補鞋履的活計。

glosses: 不專業地建造、拼湊、亂弄

examples.text: Kann Uwe denn ein Bad kacheln? Eigentlich wohl eher nicht, aber er schustert halt so gut er kann, und es sieht gar nicht mal so schlecht aus.
examples.translation: Uwe 會鋪浴室磁磚嗎？其實他應該是不會，但他也就是盡其所能地胡亂拼湊一番，結果看起來倒也沒那麼糟。

examples.text: Könntest du mir nicht mal eine Homepage schustern? Es muss nichts Besonderes sein, aber du weißt, ich bin immer so knapp bei Kasse, was Richtiges, Offizielles kann ich mir gerade nicht leisten.
examples.translation: 你能不能幫我隨便弄個網頁出來？不用多特別，你也知道我手頭很緊，那種正式像樣的我現在實在負擔不起。

glosses: 做愛，發生性行為

examples.text: Dass in Wien gerne geschustert wird, hat wenig mit Handwerk zu tun, mehr mit soustat - und das heißt dieses und nichts sonst.
examples.translation: 在維也納，人們熱衷於「修鞋」這件事跟手藝活沒什麼關係，反倒是跟 soustat 有關——而這詞指的就是那檔子事，別無其他。

glosses: สัมปทานการก พหูพจน์ของ Schuster
